results_applied: physical-pair logarithmic receiver after sqrt-small-ball remainder
COUNTEREXAMPLE_SEARCH Theorem A localized physical 3x3 density bound

new_results.statement: For A=[I3,Z]^T B[I3,Z]+D, beta=detB, G=ZZ^T, K=B+D_H, N=B^{-1}K, and one-tail/two-hub mixed-minor vector R(p), R(p)=beta adj(N)z_p and Lambda1=sum_{p,h}R_h(p)^2=beta^2 tr(adj(N)Gadj(N)^T). If D_H=0 then Lambda1=|beta|P1.
With mu=sigma_min(KB^{-1}), Lambda1>=|beta|mu^4P1; hence on P1>5P/16, Lambda1>(5/16)|beta|mu^4P.
For physical pair P_h=K[H\{h},H\{h}] and its post-completion remaining-hub-to-tail cross row n_h, ||R_h||_2=|detP_h| ||n_h||_2.
If P_h is invertible indefinite and R_h nonzero, ||p_Q||_infinity<=15.082311168072676 [sigma_min(P_h)||R_h||_2]^(-1/4), retaining arbitrary same-bank curvature and the full tail.
If every literal 2x2 pair block has sigma_min>=kappa, ||p_Q||_infinity<=max{pi/kappa,15.082311168072676[kappa^2 Lambda1/3]^(-1/8)}.

structural_counterexample.facts: P0=P1=4, P2=P3=0, Lambda1=16, all three 2x2 hub principal blocks singular; ambient spectrum {1+sqrt(5),2,1-sqrt(5),0} has three eigenvalues of modulus >=1.
structural_counterexample.target_payment: Pinned COUNTEREXAMPLE_SEARCH Theorem A applies to the hub block with c=1, giving ||p_Q||_infinity<=6sqrt(pi).
structural_counterexample.scope: Refutes only P1=>invertible two-hub extraction, not QFORM.

next_step: In the P1-large branch with the localized hub triple nonquantitative, combine Lambda1 and finite hub degeneracy (mu small and/or nearly singular pair blocks) with r53's same-bank normal curved-section theorem or the at-most-five heavy-tail-coordinate route, retaining the full diagonal tail and all spectral terms.
